name: Post Matric Scholarship To Scheduled Tribe Students Of Nagaland
benefit: 1. To provide social security provisions to the students of post-metric classes. 1. Students will be able to pursue studies. 1. To provide financial assistance to these students to complete their studies at the college level. 1. Providing socio-economic welfare to the students belonging to the residentship of Nagaland state.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be pursuing post-matric studies (above Class X) and belong to the Scheduled Tribe of Nagaland. - The applicant should have parents’/guardian’s annual income not exceeding ₹2.50 lakh from all sources. - The applicant should be studying in an institution with a valid AISHE/UDISE code. - The applicant should not be a repeater (students who failed in the last examination are not eligible). - The applicant should not have availed this scholarship at the same stage of education in a different stream or subject. - The applicant should not have a study break of more than two years. - The applicant should not be a beneficiary of any other scholarship scheme. - The applicant should not be employed in any Government or Semi-Government establishment. - The applicant should be pursuing a Diploma or Certificate course of at least two years duration, if applicable, and must fulfil all the above criteria. - The applicant should be studying under NIOS, if applicable, and must fulfil the above criteria and have passed Class 10 with English, Alternative English/MIL, Science, Mathematics, and Social Science for Class 11 or 12 level courses.
